description: Utah: UGRC statewide land information record (LIR) parcels for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md and the review record in docs/registry/sources/ut-ugrc-lir.md.

sources.notes: Statewide source: one review covers all 29 counties' LIR layers (Parcels_<County>_LIR on services1.arcgis.com/99lidPhWCzftIe9K). This config lists 26 county files: the two Tier 2 counties first, Salt Lake (item 6f900727..., 399,432 features, CSV about 164 MB) and Utah (item 69477c11..., 289,858 features), then, from the statewide extension of 2026-11-03, 24 more counties alphabetically by layer name (Beaver to Weber), each the Hub CSV of the layer's serviceItemId. Left out: Carbon (its own class vocabulary with no published definitions; the adapter does not map it), Emery and San Juan (no property class: every row Unknown or blank). Box Elder's layer is dated 2020-07-17 (CURRENT_ASOF). The Hub download API (opendata.gis.utah.gov/api/download/v1/items/<id>/csv?layers=0) answers 302 to services1.arcgis.com/.../replicafilescache/<name>.csv then 302 to a signed Azure blob; it honours Range requests (the review used 30 MB and 25 MB prefixes). The CSV header is the field aliases ('Parcel ID', 'Property Class'); the feature service uses field names. The LIR schema has NO owner column. The layers are updated by the counties yearly or more often (CURRENT_ASOF 2026-09-29 for Salt Lake, 2026-09-30 for Utah County at review). robots.txt: gis.utah.gov 'Allow: *' Crawl-delay 1; opendata.gis.utah.gov Crawl-delay 60, disallows /sites/ /admin/ /sessions/ /groups/ /people/ /workspace/ (not the download API); services1.arcgis.com has no robots.txt (HTTP 403 'Invalid URL'). Full files exceed the 50 MB review limit, so no full snapshot was taken; the weekly workflow archives them.
